summary:
iter124 — Comprehensive backend + Customer app UI verification for the NEW booking flow, custom home sections, hero slider, and regression. BACKEND: 10/10 pytest cases pass (test_booking_flow_iter124.py) covering (a) GET /api/app/home has custom:cs-demo + hero_slides, (b) GET /api/site/promotions.coupons contains AZO50, (c) POST /api/bookings/cart-quote Door Repair qty1 → pricing.total=470.82 (exact match to spec), (d) POST /api/bookings/validate-coupon AZO50 returns valid discount, (e) invalid coupon returns not-valid, (f) GET /api/bookings/slot-availability?date=<tomorrow> returns slots, (g) GET /api/wallet returns 250 for customer 9000000004, (h) admin PUT /api/admin/app-home add cs-qa (category) + cs-ban (banner) → both keys 'custom:cs-qa'/'custom:cs-ban' appear in GET /api/app/home; cs-qa contains services from selected category; restore removes them, (i) full E2E POST /api/bookings/grouped with address+scheduled_at+items creates booking (code AZOCNE77J).

FRONTEND (http://localhost:3001, 390x844): landing-page renders, HERO on fresh reload shows hero-slide-0 with hero-title='Get additional 25% off on your first booking' + hero-cta-0 ('Book now') and image background; autoplay swaps to slide 2 ('Trusted experts at your doorstep', 'Home repairs' eyebrow) within ~6s (verified in initial run). CUSTOM SECTION app-custom-cs-demo + app-custom-cs-demo-0 tile appear after scrolling (FlatList). BOOKING FLOW works end-to-end: bn-book-now → services-page (services-title='All Services', services-count='15 services', services-search 'door' → '1 service for "door"'), tap first tile → service-detail (service-name='Door Repair', service-price='₹299'), qty-plus → qty-value='2' & item-total='₹598', add-to-booking → cart-count=2 + toast 'Door Repair added to your booking', go-checkout → checkout-page with cart-line-<sid> showing correct qty/total (checkout-total=₹598 for qty2 or ₹299 for qty1 — matches API cart-quote). checkout-next → step-schedule; hitting checkout-next without slot triggers toast 'Please pick a date & time slot' (verified). Selecting day-<tomorrow yyyy-mm-dd> + slot-08:00 works. step-contact (logged in) shows addr-<id> chip prefilling addr-line='12 MG Road' + addr-pincode='800001'. step-summary shows price-breakdown (Services / Visiting charge / Surge / GST(18%) / Total). place-order → step-confirm with placed-AZOW392EY '#AZOW392EY Carpentry ₹379.56'. view-bookings navigates to /(customer)/orders.

REGRESSION: bn-membership → membership-page ✓, app-location-pill single-tap opens app-location-sheet ✓, hero-slide-0 & hero-cta-0 present, custom:cs-demo tiles render. Expo bundle serves fine (frontend loads).

CRITICAL FINDINGS:
1. BUG (HIGH): coupon-apply on checkout step-summary sends the /api/bookings/validate-coupon call WITHOUT the auth token — response is 401 'Not authenticated' (coupon-msg='Not authenticated', price-breakdown unchanged). The endpoint requires auth (Depends(get_current_user)) and the UI is logged in (place-order succeeds), so this is purely the missing Authorization header on the checkout page's coupon POST. Same request works from backend tests when Bearer token is supplied.
2. BUG (RECURRING — MEDIUM, 4th report): after successful booking, view-bookings navigates to /(customer)/orders but page-title still shows '(customer)' instead of 'My Bookings'. The current [tab].tsx code (const segs = [String(params.tab||''), ...pathname.split('/')].flatMap(x=>x.split('/')).filter(x=>x && !x.startsWith('('))) should filter out the '(customer)' route-group value, so either params.tab is returning a non-'('-prefixed value like the encoded '%28customer%29' OR pathname on expo-router web returns '/(customer)/orders' but somehow (customer) survives the filter. Reported as recurring across iter121/122/123 — E1 fix applied but STILL broken.

ui_bugs.issue: coupon-apply on step-summary calls POST /api/bookings/validate-coupon WITHOUT Authorization header — backend requires auth (Depends(get_current_user)) and returns 401 'Not authenticated'. Reproduce: login as customer, add a service to cart, go to checkout, complete schedule + contact, on step-summary enter 'AZO50' + tap coupon-apply → coupon-msg shows 'Not authenticated' and price-breakdown does not update. Fix: attach the same auth header the rest of the booking flow uses (the place-order/grouped call works, so token is available in state — pass it to the validate-coupon fetch too).

RECURRING (4th report — iter121, iter122, iter123, now iter124). After view-bookings → /(customer)/orders, page-title still shows '(customer)' instead of 'My Bookings'. Current filter `!x.startsWith('(')` should exclude the group name; suspect params.tab is URL-encoded ('%28customer%29') on expo-router web so the startsWith check misses it. Fix candidate: normalize with decodeURIComponent AND strip parentheses, e.g. `const clean = (x:string) => { const d = decodeURIComponent(x||''); return d.replace(/[()]/g,''); }; const segs = [clean(String(params.tab||'')), ...pathname.split('/').map(clean)].filter(x=>x && x!=='customer' && !x.startsWith('('));` — or hardcode a route-group blacklist ['customer','site','auth'] to filter out. Then NAV.find(n=>n.key==='orders') → 'My Bookings'.

action_items: (HIGH) Attach Authorization Bearer token to the checkout page's coupon-apply POST /api/bookings/validate-coupon call in /app/Customer/app/(site)/book.tsx — currently sends no auth header and always returns 401 'Not authenticated'.

(MEDIUM, RECURRING 4TH TIME) Fix /app/Customer/app/(customer)/[tab].tsx page-title fallback so that '/(customer)/orders' yields seg='orders' → 'My Bookings' on expo-router web. The current !startsWith('(') filter is not catching all cases (possibly URL-encoded). See fix suggestions in ui_bugs above.
critical_code_review_comments: Booking end-to-end is functional (place-order works, order code returned, navigation to bookings page). Only the coupon validation call on checkout is missing its auth token — a simple header omission.
Cart-quote pricing matches spec exactly (Door Repair qty1 → ₹470.82; qty2 → ₹598 net-of-tax; final total with surge+visiting+GST shown correctly in UI price-breakdown).
Custom sections resolver in /app/backend/controllers/app_home_controller.py correctly produces both 'custom:<id>' service-list and banner sections; UI renders app-custom-<id> row after scrolling.
Address prefill from saved addr-<id> chip works (addr-line & addr-pincode populate) — address auto-flow verified.
Hero slider poster style renders (background image + eyebrow + headline + Book now → CTA) and autoplays every ~4.5s; both slide 0 and slide 1 visible via testIDs.

[tab].tsx bug persists after 3 prior reports — E1's latest attempt still doesn't work on expo-router web. Root cause likely URL-encoding of route-group name in params.tab. Consider hardcoding a group blacklist as a robust workaround.

success_rate.frontend: ≈90% — booking flow, custom sections, hero, regression all pass; coupon auth bug + recurring page-title bug outstanding

seed_data_creation: During E2E test, one booking placed for customer 9000000004 (code AZOCNE77J via backend test, plus AZOW392EY via UI test). Admin custom_sections cs-qa/cs-ban were added and restored back to original (cs-demo only). Verified via GET /api/admin/app-home at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After E1 fixes: (1) coupon-apply auth header — retest by logging in as customer, adding Door Repair to cart, completing schedule+contact steps, then AZO50 apply on summary — expect coupon-msg success and price total drop of ₹150 (50% of 299 subject to max_discount 150). (2) [tab].tsx — retest by logging in, tap bn-bookings on landing → expect page-title 'My Bookings'. Every other flow (services, service-detail, cart, checkout steps 0-4, custom sections, hero autoplay, membership, location sheet) is verified working — do not need re-test unless underlying files change. Backend cart-quote and custom-section endpoints are stable.
rca of the issue: COUPON 401: /app/Customer/app/(site)/book.tsx's coupon-apply handler fetches POST /api/bookings/validate-coupon without an Authorization header. The endpoint requires an authenticated user (booking_routes.py line 24: `user=Depends(get_current_user)`), and the request is silently rejected as 401. UI catches the error and displays the raw detail 'Not authenticated'. Fix: reuse the token/apiClient used by placeOrder for the coupon call. PAGE-TITLE '(customer)': see extensive RCA in iter122/123 reports — /app/Customer/app/(customer)/[tab].tsx tries to filter route-group values but expo-router web appears to expose '(customer)' in params.tab in a form that bypasses the `.startsWith('(')` filter (URL-encoded '%28customer%29' would render as literal '(customer)' after implicit decoding in the Text component). Safer fix: use a hardcoded segment blacklist (['customer','site','auth']) instead of relying on paren prefix.
